title: Scimitar Cuts for the Awakened
summary: Builds on the basic cuts with qi carried through the wrist for students who have passed the Second Awakening.

title: The Qi-Fed Curve
summary: Shows how qi fed along the curve of the blade lengthens the cut and softens the guard.

title: A Treatise on the Drawing Slash
summary: Examines the pulling cut of the scimitar and the two qi-aided forms taught at intermediate level.

title: Intermediate Drills for the Broad Blade
summary: Sets paired drills that join basic cuts to three qi-driven forms for students beyond the first year.

title: The Scimitar Master's Drill-Book
summary: A long drill-book of stance and cut and counter that closes with three qi-aided forms.

title: Circling Cuts and Hooked Counters
summary: Teaches the circling cut and the hooked counter that follows it for students at the Warrior stage.

title: The Saddle-and-Ground Canon
summary: Sets out how qi-aided cuts differ when fought from a saddle and when fought on foot.

title: A Short Treatise on Tempo and Curve
summary: A short work on timing a curved cut against a straight guard with two intermediate forms.

title: Lessons in the Binding Hook
summary: Gives the scimitar's hooking work and three intermediate binds to students holding the earlier hall manuals.
